98298.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Arugal's Folly
english.detail: Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds. These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how. Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
english.objective: Bring 6 Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
english.progress: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.
english.complete:
It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is.
These pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt.
Regrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.

99048.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: A Missing Hand
english.detail: A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in. I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
english.objective: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
english.complete:
Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.
Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.

99049.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Threat from Below
english.detail: The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened. Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
english.objective: Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.
english.complete:
This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north.
We cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.

99050.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: The Great Tree Provides
english.detail: I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment. Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need. The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest. In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
english.objective: Collect 6 Dewy Lasher Fronds, an Empty Vial, and a Refreshing Spring Water for Byancie in Dolanaar.
english.progress: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
english.complete:
Thank you for your help. Please, accept this to help with the costs of the vial and water.
Now, to make the salve. It should only take a moment.

99051.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Threat from Below
english.detail: It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here. Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.
english.objective: Collect 9 Naga Spinefins.
english.progress: Hopefully those snake scum aren't giving you trouble?
english.complete: Hopefully that sends them packing back to the north. I'll have some grunts keep an eye out for any stragglers or funny business.

99052.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Threat from Below
english.detail: One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case. It's a young one, but it could still rip an orc in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.
english.objective: Kill the sea giant along Durotar's north coast and bring back proof of your accomplishment.
english.complete:
Ha! I could hear his body fall from here!
Be proud of your kill today; not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.

99053.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Escaping Ban'ethil
english.detail: My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here. I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal. I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
english.objective: Help Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom escape Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and report her safety to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.
english.complete:
Thank Elune you were around to help Lynessa avoid a dark fate with the Gnarlpine. She's one of our best, and a personal friend.
Please, take this in thanks. May it serve you well in keeping the kaldorei safe.

99073.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Easing Suffering
english.detail: The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly. I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads. It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.
english.objective: Take the Lashwater Salve to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road to the Oracle Tree.
english.progress: <Eralya has stopped responding verbally. Only a weak, gurgled exhale confirms life.>
english.complete: <Eralya's breath calms quickly as you help her ingest the salve. She may not survive, but is at relative peace.>

99079.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Longwalker Malah
english.detail: The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid. This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety. I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
english.objective: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.
english.complete: It is clear that Malah did not die naturally. Arrows cover her back and the ground nearby.

99080.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Drive Them Out
english.detail: Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur. Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid. If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
english.objective: Kill 6 Galak Centaurs, 4 Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.
english.complete:
You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.
I could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!
Today marks a great victory for our village, and a sense of security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young <class>.

99081.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Grim Tidings
english.detail: You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore. The Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.
english.objective: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.
english.complete: This is most dire news indeed. We must inform Baine at once!

99082.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: The High Chieftain
english.detail: Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father. It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored. You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
english.objective: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
english.complete:
The Galak centaur dare show themselves in Mulgore?!
You have brought pride to your ancestors by driving them out. Perhaps that will remind them of the pain that awaits them should they do so again!
Please accept this gift in honor of this. May it serve you well as you venture out into the Earth Mother's kingdom, to the far reaches of this world.

99101.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Our Ancient Enemy
english.detail: Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once. Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town. Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!
english.objective: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.
english.progress: What is it you bring me, <class>?
english.complete:
<Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.>
This will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, <name>.

99123.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Lost in the Shadows
english.detail: I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since. If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.
english.objective: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
english.complete:
Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she?
Hopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising hunter, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.

99127.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: A Net Disaster
english.detail: The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all. Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
english.objective: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.
english.complete: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.

99128.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Slimy Menace
english.detail: This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
english.objective: Kill 7 Murlocs and 4 Murloc Streamrunner at Crystal Lake, then return to Jason Mathers.
english.complete: I can hear their warbling from here--it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.

99129.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: A Man About a Murloc
english.detail: Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.
english.objective: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.
english.complete:
I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.
I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.

99130.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: An Enticing Offer
english.detail: I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process. There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away. And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.
english.objective: Collect 6 Vials of Animal Blood and 18 Duskweed Petals for murloc bait, then return to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.
english.complete:
Give me just a minute...
It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.

99131.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Baited for Success
english.detail: Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage. Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.
english.objective: Return to Jason Mathers.
english.complete: Poisoned bait? As long as the fish aren't going to eat it, that should work. I'll visit Remy later to pick it up.

99134.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Discipline
english.detail: You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me. As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess. Swiftly now--<name>, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
english.objective: Punish 5 Deathguards for Executor Zygand.
english.complete:
There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.
You please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.

99141.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Patience
english.detail: Make no mistake, <class>--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens. Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name. You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
english.objective: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
english.progress: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
english.complete:
I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.
You have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.

99143.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Bottles and Baubles
english.detail: Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like! If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
english.objective: Collect 6 pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.
english.progress: What did you find? Anything interesting?
english.complete:
An interesting collection. These should work well enough!
Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.

99152.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: As Above, So Below
english.detail: While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep. I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course. Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
english.objective: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
english.progress: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
english.complete:
Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.
With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.

99153.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: The One That Got Away
english.detail: Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas. Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one. Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
english.objective: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
english.progress: Did you find the damned thing?
english.complete: Well done--and quick, too! Now onto my favorite part...

99156.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Rear Guard Patrol
english.detail: Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale. Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed. Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal. See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
english.objective: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.
english.progress: Have you dealt with our little problem?
english.complete:
You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have.
Please accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.

99411.sourceKind: Current primary English via web reader after repository fetcher HTTP403; whitespace/links normalized

english.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!
english.detail:
Help, <name>! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.
Will you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.
To feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
english.objective:
Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.
Feed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.
english.complete: Fantastic work, <name>! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.
